text.zh_CN: 成交了。打开交易台里的「查看首笔成交与复盘」，看看你实际付了多少钱、占用多少仓位。再想一想，什么情况会让你离场？
text.en: Your order filled. Open “Review your first fill” at the trade desk to see what you paid and how large the position is. Then decide what would make you exit.

text.zh_CN: 还在纠结复盘理由？我早盘两笔短线已经获利平仓了。市场奖励的是执行速度，等你慢吞吞写完日志，好机会早跑光了。
text.en: Still sweating over a trade journal? I've already closed two intraday scalps in the green. The market pays for speed. By the time you finish writing, the alpha is gone.

text.zh_CN: 跑得快的人往往撞墙也最狠。成交不是结束，是复盘开始的地方。看着你的持仓面板，选一个你现在最想检查的数据。
text.en: Those who run fastest usually hit walls hardest. A fill is not the end; it's where the review begins. Look at your portfolio panel: what do you want to inspect right now?

text.zh_CN: 选一个你现在最想检查的东西。
text.en: Pick what you want to inspect right now.

text.zh_CN: 成交后的盘口深度和滑点。
text.en: Book depth and slippage after the fill.

text.zh_CN: 先搞清楚订单类型和成交规则。
text.en: First, understand order types and matching rules.

text.zh_CN: 很好。成本基础决定了你真正的盈亏底线，持仓占比决定了你今晚能不能睡着。打开成交复盘，把这两个数字和你的计划对照一下。
text.en: Good. Cost basis defines your real P&L baseline; position weight defines whether you can sleep tonight. Compare those two numbers with your plan in the fill review.

text.zh_CN: 盘口会告诉你成交的代价。大单吃掉几档深度，滑点就会吃掉你的利润。下次先看买卖五档，再决定下单数量。
text.en: The book tells you the cost of trading. Large orders eat through depth, and slippage eats your edge. Check the book before sizing next time.

text.zh_CN: 最不花哨、也最值钱的选择。市价单追求成交，限价单追求价格；止损单等待触发。搞清规则，再谈策略。
text.en: The least flashy and most valuable choice. Market orders chase fills; limit orders chase price; stop orders wait for triggers. Master rules before strategy.
